transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Just... having some trouble, I guess. It's like... I don't know, I just feel like I got a motor running inside me all day. If I gotta sit still—like at church, or at home, or even just out there in the clinic waiting room—I start feeling... trapped. I just gotta get up and do something. That's... pretty much it.
Do you often have trouble finishing tasks because your mind drifts off?

Yeah, I guess. Like... if folks are talking about, you know, when we're getting rides somewhere, or what we need from the pantry, or stuff for church... I hear 'em at first. But then... I don't know, my mind just slips off somewhere else. I end up missing pieces I probably should've heard.
Have you had these trouble-with-focus and fidgety feelings since you were a child?

Yeah... I suppose so. 

Back when I was a boy, in school... teachers were always moving my seat. Said I couldn't stay put. I'd talk out of turn, get in trouble for jumping up before class was even done... stuff like that.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things most days?
No... not really. I don't reckon I sit around worrying about stuff much. Just... ain't really something I do.
Do these symptoms cause problems in your day-to-day life?

Yeah... I guess they do. 

It's just... folks at the church, and down at the pantry... even my own family... they don't really trust me with things no more. Like rides, or keeping track of appointments, or fetching supplies. 

I don't mean to mess it up. I want to help 'em out, I really do. But... I just keep letting everybody down.
